blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ عَنْ اَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ﵁ اَنَّ رَجُلاً مَرَّ بِهِ وَهُوَ يَغْرِسُ غَرْسًا بِدِمَشْقَ فَقَالَ لَهُ: أَتَفْعَلُ هذَا وَاَنْتَ صَاحِبُ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ ﷺ، فَقَالَ: لَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيَّ سَمِعْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ: مَنْ غَرَسَ غَرْسًا لَمْ يَأْكُلْ مِنْهُ آدَمِيٌّ وَلَا خَلْقٌ مِنْ خَلْقِ اللهِ اِلَّا كَانَ لَهُ صَدَقَةٌ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Qasim (RH) says: “In the city of Damascus, while Hazrat Abu Darda (RA) was planting a tree, a man passed by Hazrat Abu Darda (RA). He said to Hazrat Abu Darda (RA), “You are a companion of the Prophet ﷺ, and yet you too are occupied in (worldly) affairs?' Hazrat Abu Darda (RA) said, “Do not be hasty in finding fault with me. I have heard Rasulullah ﷺ say, “Whoever plants a tree, and a human or any one of the creatures of Allah Ta'ala eats from that tree, his planting the tree becomes a means of his receiving the reward of giving charity.””

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ اَيُّوْبَ اْلاَنْصَارِيِّ ﵁ عَنْ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ ﷺ اَنَّهُ قَالَ: مَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ يَغْرِسُ غَرْسًا اِلَّا كَتَبَ اللهُ لَهُ مِنَ اْلاَجْرِ قَدْرَ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْ ثَمَرِ ذلِكَ الغِرَاسِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Whoever plants a tree, Allah Ta'ala will write reward for the one who planted the tree according to the amount of fruit produced from that tree.”
